cases.name: baseline_deterministic
cases.description: Control scenario with two transactions expected to produce deterministic ordering and totals in optimized implementation.
cases.flaky_signature: Minimal variance expected; used to detect unnecessary jitter

expected.Project_A: Variable totals due to random noise

cases.name: concurrency_race
cases.description: Duplicate transactions forcing contention in shared state when processed concurrently.
cases.flaky_signature: Trending order differs between runs in Project A; stable in Project B.

cases.name: empty_batch
cases.flaky_signature: Project A may return stale cache values; Project B returns zero totals.

cases.name: malformed_payload
cases.description: Invalid timestamps and channel values to test validation paths.
cases.flaky_signature: Project A may throw inconsistent exceptions or proceed; Project B raises ValidationError.

cases.name: state_leakage
cases.description: Repeated processing of identical payloads to expose global state reuse.
cases.flaky_signature: Project A totals drift upwards; Project B remains constant.
